reasoning: The agent keeps a rough, mostly-implicit checklist of features done vs remaining and clearly notices when it repeatedly fails on the same input (repetitive.zst, then audio.wav.zst), matching the level-5 anchor. It shows some level-8 behavior — switching diagnostic tactics (hardcode vs compute, narrower input, debug traces) and re-diagnosing with fresh hypotheses — but this is undercut by extended circular thrashing (steps 49-60), a coverage picture bounded by the visible sanity set rather than the full feature matrix, and a stretch of inaccurate self-state about its own source file. This places it at the 5 anchor, a touch below the explicit-accurate-coverage-map standard of 8.
